component.name: Funnel
component.summary: Sort any folder automatically with your own rules

description.p: Funnel watches the folders you choose and moves new files into tidy, rule-based subfolders. Point it at Downloads and your screenshots land in Photos, PDFs in Documents and archives in Archives — automatically.
Every move is journaled and reversible, rules are editable in a visual editor with a plain-English preview, and the whole thing stays quietly out of your way in the background.

The "Tunneler" release: a six-step rule wizard, a redesigned rules page, journal search with restore preview and conflict strategies, configurable history retention, light/dark appearance with per-rule accent colours, Flatpak packaging, and channel-aware updates.
Journal search, restore preview, the rule wizard and the redesigned rules page.
